crossRefs.note: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…
He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, “Teacher, don’t you care that…
He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging…
Asa cried to Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, there is no one besides you to help, between the mighty and him who has…
Our God, will you not judge them? For we have no might against this great company that comes against us. We don’t know…
So the ship master came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God! Maybe your God…

translations.web: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”
translations.bsb: The disciples went and woke Him, saying, “Lord, save us! We are perishing!”
translations.kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
translations.asv: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Save, Lord; we perish.
